findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing its abstract methods
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler` with a `pass` body, leaving the `@abc.abstractmethod` members `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data` unimplemented. Previously it implemented `DetectorHandler.evaluate` as a no-op stub returning `[]`. Now, accessing `detector.detector_handler` for a `MetricAlertFire` detector (in `Detector.detector_handler` at `src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86`) will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` at runtime.

findings.title: get_group_key_values return type annotation disallows None group keys
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.get_group_key_values` is annotated to return `dict[str, int]`, whereas group keys throughout the module are typed as `DetectorGroupKey` (which allows `None`, as seen in `build_dedupe_value_key`, `bulk_get_detector_state`, and tests passing `{None: 6}`). `evaluate()` passes `list(group_values.keys())` directly to `get_state_data(group_keys: list[DetectorGroupKey])` and `evaluate_group_key_value(group_key: DetectorGroupKey, ...)`. The return annotation on `get_group_key_values` should be `dict[DetectorGroupKey, int]`.

findings.title: build_mock_occurrence_and_event ignores the value argument and tests pass mismatched arguments
findings.body: `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` does not include `value` in the returned `IssueOccurrence` or `event_data`, and `IssueOccurrence.__eq__` only compares a subset of fields (not including `fingerprint`). As a result, several tests pass wrong arguments when constructing the expected occurrence without failing: e.g., `test_state_results_multi_group` (line 191) passes `value=6` instead of `10` for `group_2`, `TestEvaluate.test_results_on_change` (line 490) and `test_dedupe` (line 510) pass `6` instead of `100` and `8`, and `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` (line 537) passes `group_key="val1", value=6` when evaluating `"group_key"` with value `10`. Including `value` in `evidence_data` (and asserting `fingerprint` or `to_dict()`) would ensure the tests actually verify the arguments passed to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.
